summary.zh: 红黑白的斜切菜单。选中时一块红色锯齿碎片“砸”到文字后面，文字反色放大，其它选项抖一下，怪盗猫从右边换个姿势探出来；确认时一道红黑斜楔擦过屏幕进入子面板，Esc 再擦回来。
summary.en: A skewed red, black and white menu. Selecting slams a jagged red shard behind the label, the label inverts and scales up, the other items jitter and the phantom cat pops in with a new pose. Confirm and a red-black wedge wipes into a sub-panel; Esc wipes back.

technique.zh: 碎片是两层 clip-path 多边形（红 + 白）。换行时用 WAAPI 从旧行甩到新行，中间那一帧沿竖直方向拉长 + skew 当拖影，落位过冲。擦屏是两块 skewX(-24deg) 的大色块错开 70ms 扫过，黑块盖满全屏的那一刻切换内容。标题是剪报字：每个字母一张不同的“剪纸”。
technique.en: The shard is two clip-path polygons (red + white). Switching rows flings it with WAAPI; the middle keyframe stretches it vertically and skews it as a smear, then it overshoots into place. The wipe is two skewX(-24deg) slabs offset by 70ms; content swaps when the black one covers the screen. The title is ransom-note letters, each a different cut-out.

desc.zh: 碎片砸进来的时长（带过冲）

adapt.zh: 游戏化的设置页、彩蛋菜单、活动页。键盘 ↑↓ Enter Esc 都已经接好。
adapt.en: Gamified settings, easter-egg menus, campaign pages. ↑↓ Enter Esc are wired up.
